Some claims support assistance to Palestinians, while others call for ending weapons sales to Israel and opposing retaliatory measures against the Palestinian Authority. claims.claim_text: Commitment to the creation of a comprehensive, just and lasting peace between Israel and its neighbors.
Support for national sovereignty for the Palestinian people.
Support for recognizing the right of the Palestinian people to resist military occupation.
Demand for the fulfillment of the right of all Palestinians to return to their homeland.
Support for Israel's right to exist as a Jewish state with secure, defensible borders.
Commitment to restore critical assistance to the Palestinian people in the West Bank and Gaza, consistent with U.S. law.
Demand for an end to Israel’s structural violence and systematic destruction of Palestinian lives and livelihoods.
Support for recognizing the rights of the Palestinian people, including the right of return.
Support for the creation of a democratic Palestinian state dedicated to living in peace and security side by side with the Jewish State of Israel.
Opposition to retaliatory measures against the Palestinian Authority.
Support for ending weapons sales to Israel.
